svg.title: Parallels: send macOS system shortcuts to Omarchy
svg.desc: Animated guide, four numbered steps. 1: in Parallels Desktop press Command and comma to open Settings. 2: click Shortcuts in the toolbar. 3: click macOS System Shortcuts in the sidebar. 4: open the menu 'Send macOS system shortcuts' and choose Always; the shortcuts in the list below become checked. Then Command+Space in the VM opens Omarchy's app launcher instead of Spotlight. A pointer walks through the clicks while the numbered list on the right ticks off each step.

g.text: press ⌘ , in Parallels Desktop: its Settings open
set Send macOS system shortcuts to Always
done: ⌘ Space and friends now reach Omarchy
Shortcuts sent to the virtual machine

svg.text: OmacVM shows this guide and tells you when the setting is on; Parallels does not let other apps change it
